title: Band-9 Samples: How many languages can you speak? [Why/why not?]
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 15 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 1 Test 2 question: “How many languages can you speak? [Why/why not?]” Sample 1: Limited Bilingual Female Male My mother tongue is the sole language I can confidently say I’m fluent in. Despite my endeavors to acquire English, I still find myself grappling with the nuances of the language. Nevertheless, I remain undeterred and am determined to persevere until I gain proficiency. Sample 2: Limited Bilingual Female Male I’ve honed my skills in my native language, but cracking the code of the English language has proven to be an uphill battle for me. While I can understand basic English, I haven’t yet managed to wrap my head around the perplexing grammar and idiomatic expressions. Sample 3: Limited Bilingual Female Male My linguistic abilities encompass a pair of languages, with my mother tongue being my forte. While I have some proficiency in English, I wouldn’t say I’m entirely fluent. As a result, I’ve opted to concentrate on polishing my English skills instead of spreading myself too thin across multiple languages. Sample 4: Limited Bilingual Female Male I can confidently speak my mother tongue, but my English fluency is far from ideal. Overcoming the fear of making mistakes has been a significant barrier in my language-learning journey. Nevertheless, I’m determined to conquer this mental hurdle and fully embrace the process of mastering English. Sample 5: Bilingual Female Male My linguistic abilities encompass Vietnamese and English, making me a bilingual speaker. This accomplishment is the result of my insatiable thirst for knowledge and my penchant for learning about other cultures. By mastering these two languages, I have successfully bridged the gap between East and West, allowing me to weave through different social circles with ease. Sample 6: Bilingual Female Male I can fluently converse in two languages, namely English and Spanish. My bilingual abilities stem from my upbringing in a multicultural household, which provided me with ample opportunities to practice both languages and appreciate the nuances of each. Sample 7: Bilingual Female Male My linguistic repertoire comprises two languages, with a solid command of both my native language and English. This proficiency has been honed through extensive study and practice, rendering me capable of engaging in thought-provoking conversations with people from different cultures. Sample 8: Multilingual Female Male As a polyglot, I’m proficient in four languages: English, French, Spanish, and Mandarin. The catalyst for my linguistic journey was a thirst for understanding different cultures and connecting with people from diverse backgrounds. By embracing the nuances of each language, I’ve broadened my horizons and enhanced my global perspective. Sample 9: Multilingual Female Male I can comfortably communicate in three languages: English, German, and Japanese. My linguistic prowess was nurtured by my ceaseless wanderlust and an innate desire to break down barriers between people. The ability to converse in multiple languages has opened doors to countless opportunities and enriched my life immeasurably. Sample 10: Multilingual Female Male I possess the aptitude to communicate effectively in four languages, which comprise English, Swahili, Portuguese, and Korean. My parents were globetrotters, and we frequently relocated to different countries during my childhood. This exposure to diverse cultures and languages helped me develop a natural affinity for learning new languages.
